excavation_context.character_description: Adult female grad student, long blonde hair, tanned skin, wearing a white sun hat, light pink blouse under a khaki safari vest, and white shorts.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_1 is climbing an ancient, rocky riverbed gorge channel. She points her flashlight at a crumbling block of pebble-packed tan conglomerate matrix. Trapped within the packed gravel texture is a thick, water-worn sauropod limb joint. Dramatic high-contrast shadows defining the bumpy pebble shapes. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
